_readme: PRIVATE client data. This file lives in worker/, which is never served as a static file, and it is only read by the Worker to compute one combined total for the homepage (GET /api/client-revenue). Individual figures are never sent to the browser or shown anywhere. To add a figure, set `revenue` to a number (annual revenue in CAD; if the client gave a range, use its lower bound). Only add a figure the client has agreed to share. Leave it null to leave the client out of the total.
